Guided facade still borrows measured endpoint length for lo/hi, but its lattice closure ignores the supplied original anchor/direction and actually uses the proposal anchor/direction. def _edge_chains(image, mask, lab, gradients, k, mate, point, mate_point, projection,
                 face, cfg):
    q = np.asarray(point['xy'], float)
    model_guide = projection[mate]-projection[k]
    model_length = float(np.linalg.norm(model_guide))
    output = dict(native_corner=k, native_neighbor=mate, native_edge=[k, mate],
                  supported=False, chains=[], selected_chain_index=None,
                  face_association=deepcopy(face),
                  native_association_is_conditional_on_initial_geometry=True,
                  actual_native_identity_certified=False,
                  neighbor_image_coordinate_used=mate_point is not None,
                  neighbor_unknown_corner_queries=0, S_local_queries=0,
                  guide_defines_measurement_direction=False,
                  measurement_source='ACTUAL_IMAGE_NMS_CHAIN_WITH_MASK_CONTEXT',
                  image_peak_localization='integer image lattice -> image-gradient NMS/subpixel peak -> connected chain TLS',
                  full_2D_corner_created=False, GT_inputs=False)
    if model_length < 10:
        return dict(output, reason='short_model_only_incident_guide')
    seed_normal = np.array([-model_guide[1], model_guide[0]])/model_length
    context = max(cfg['RGB_probe_px'], cfg['boundary_context_px'])
    unknown_mate = None
    if mate_point is None:
        direction = model_guide/model_length
        lo = cfg['along_start_px']
        hi = min(cfg['along_end_px'], .8*model_length, model_length-context)
        unknown_mate = projection[mate]
        whole = False
    else:
        vector = np.asarray(mate_point['xy'], float)-q
        length = float(np.linalg.norm(vector))
        if length < 10: return dict(output, reason='short_visible_endpoint_segment')
        direction = vector/length
        lo, hi = cfg['along_start_px'], length-cfg['along_start_px']
        whole = True
    if hi <= lo: return dict(output, reason='no_actual_search_span_before_mate')
    xy, along = _lattice_strip(q, direction, lo, hi, cfg['normal_search_radius_px'],
                               image.shape[:2], unknown_mate, context)

def _guided_edge(image, mask, lab, gradients, proposal, points, cfg, visibility_context=None):
    k, mate = proposal['native_corner'], proposal['native_neighbor']
    anchor = np.asarray(proposal['anchor_xy'])
    direction = np.asarray(proposal['direction_xy'])
    length = proposal['model_length_px']
    # Search-only coordinates set the frozen TLS seed, never the reported line.
    search_projection = {k:anchor, mate:anchor+direction*length}
    actual_unknown = proposal['original_unknown_mate_model_xy']
    original_lattice = NMS._lattice_strip
    query_audit=[]
    def lattice(a, ignored_direction, lo, hi, radius, hw, ignored_unknown, context):
        xy,along=original_lattice(anchor, direction, lo, hi, radius, hw,
            None if actual_unknown is None else np.asarray(actual_unknown), context)
        before=len(xy)
        if visibility_context is not None and len(xy):
            keep=visibility_context.query_allowed(k,mate,xy,context_radius_px=context)
            xy,along=xy[keep],along[keep]
        query_audit.append(dict(search_anchor_xy=anchor.tolist(),search_direction_xy=direction.tolist(),
            along_interval_px=[float(lo),float(hi)],normal_radius_px=float(radius),
            lattice_pixels_before_additional_exclusion=before,lattice_pixels_after_exclusion=len(xy)))
        return xy,along
    namespace = dict(NMS._edge_chains.__globals__)
    namespace['_lattice_strip'] = lattice
    call = FunctionType(NMS._edge_chains.__code__, namespace)
    out = call(image, mask, lab, gradients, k, mate, points[k]['record'],
        points[mate]['record'] if mate in points else None, search_projection,
        proposal['face_association'], cfg)
    out.update(guide_proposal=deepcopy(proposal), frozen17c_NMS_TLS_math=True,
        proposed_direction_is_not_measured_line=True, original_unknown_mate_exclusion_preserved=True,
        actual_query_strip_audit=query_audit)
    for chain in [*out.get('chains',[]),*out.get('rejected_chains',[])]:
        if 'observed_points' not in chain:continue
        normal,offset,actual=_actual_line(chain)
        values=(actual-anchor)@direction
        chain['legacy_observed_endpoint_reference_support']=chain.pop('endpoint_support',None)
        chain['query_strip_actual_support']=dict(along_min_px=float(values.min()),along_max_px=float(values.max()),
            query_anchor_xy=anchor.tolist(),query_direction_xy=direction.tolist(),
            measured_BI_reference_xy=proposal['observed_BI_reference_xy'],
            endpoint_reference_normal_shift_px=float(abs(normal@np.asarray(proposal['observed_BI_reference_xy'])+offset)))

findings.fact: ORDER filters model directions against observed BI hemisphere, yet only invokes this support test for nonparallel incident pairs at their inferred intersection. A single retained line does not receive that unary native-q sided-support test. Downstream owner sign is fixed from BI q, but the finite/directed guard is applied to candidate model vertices, so a candidate pose can move to the chosen support while the good saved e is rejected.

def _compatible_directions(k,mate,p,normal,points,guide_bank,cfg):
    tangent=np.array([-normal[1],normal[0]])
    measured=None
    if k in points and mate in points:
        delta=np.asarray(points[mate]['record']['xy'])-np.asarray(points[k]['record']['xy'])
        if np.linalg.norm(delta)>=10.:
            measured=delta/np.linalg.norm(delta)
    records=[]
    if measured is not None:
        records.append(dict(source='MEASURED_BI_ENDPOINT_ORDER',direction=measured))
    edge=sorted([k,mate])
    for guide in guide_bank['guide_proposals']:
        if guide['native_edge']!=edge:continue
        sign=1. if guide['native_corner']==k else -1.
        reference=np.asarray(guide['direction_xy'])*sign
        if guide.get('vanishing_point_h') is None:
            direction=reference/np.linalg.norm(reference)
        else:
            try:direction=OLD.vanishing_direction_at(guide['vanishing_point_h'],p,sign_reference=reference)
            except ValueError:continue
        # Endpoint positions may be noisy normal to the edge; the orientation
        # hemisphere is still measured. Do not allow a coarse pose to invert it.
        if measured is not None and direction@measured<=0:continue
        records.append(dict(source=guide['guide_id'],direction=direction))
    unique={}
    diagnostics=[]
    for r in records:
        d=np.asarray(r['direction'])
        cosine=float(tangent@d)
        angle=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(abs(cosine),0,1))))
        compatible=angle<=cfg['maximum_direction_change_deg']+1e-9
        diagnostics.append(dict(source=r['source'],angle_to_measured_line_deg=angle,
            line_angle_compatible=compatible,measured_BI_hemisphere_used=measured is not None))
        if compatible:
            orientation=1 if cosine>=0 else -1
            unique.setdefault(orientation,[]).append(r['source'])
    return tangent,unique,diagnostics,measured is not None


def _support(k,mate,p,node,points,guide_bank,cfg):
    normal=np.asarray(node['normal'],float)
    actual=np.asarray(node['actual_inliers'],float)
    tangent,orientations,angles,measured=_compatible_directions(k,mate,p,normal,points,guide_bank,cfg)
    alternatives=[]
    for sign,sources in sorted(orientations.items()):
        ordered_tangent=tangent*sign
        distances=(actual-p)@ordered_tangent
        fraction=float(np.mean(distances>=-SIDE_MARGIN_PX))
        alternatives.append(dict(direction_sources=sources,ordered_tangent_xy=ordered_tangent.tolist(),
            supported_fraction=fraction,passes=fraction+1e-12>=cfg['minimum_inlier_fraction'],
            minimum_signed_support_px=float(distances.min()),maximum_signed_support_px=float(distances.max()),
            actual_inlier_count=len(actual)))
    passing=[a for a in alternatives if a['passes']]
    return dict(native_corner=k,native_neighbor=mate,line_name=node['name'],
        passes=bool(passing),side_margin_px=SIDE_MARGIN_PX,minimum_fraction=cfg['minimum_inlier_fraction'],
        measured_BI_mate_order_used=measured,orientation_ambiguous_across_model_guides=len(orientations)>1,
        angle_compatibility=angles,directed_support_alternatives=alternatives,
        best_supported_fraction=max([a['supported_fraction'] for a in alternatives],default=0.),
        reason='ordered_actual_support_pass' if passing else
            'no_angle_compatible_order_direction' if not alternatives else 'actual_support_is_on_wrong_native_endpoint_side',

def _ordered_score(selected,points,states,guide_bank,cfg,graph_cfg):
    score=OLD._score_graph(selected,points,states,guide_bank,cfg,graph_cfg)
    nodes=[n for n in selected if n is not None]
    checks=[];angle_checks=[]
    for k in sorted(points):
        if states[k]not in('B','I'):continue
        incident=[n for n in nodes if k in n['native_edge']]
        for a,b in combinations(incident,2):
            key=tuple(sorted([a['name'],b['name']]))
            cache=guide_bank['_cached_intersections']
            if key not in cache:
                cache[key]=OLD._intersection((a['normal'],a['offset']),(b['normal'],b['offset']),cfg['minimum_intersection_sine'])
            p,sine=cache[key]
            angle_checks.append(dict(native_corner=k,line_names=[a['name'],b['name']],
                sine=sine,minimum_sine=cfg['minimum_intersection_sine'],passes=p is not None))
            if p is None:continue  # Near-parallel remains a line/range hypothesis, never a junction.
            for node in (a,b):
                mate=next(i for i in node['native_edge'] if i!=k)
                checks.append(_support(k,mate,p,node,points,guide_bank,cfg))
    failed=[c for c in checks if not c['passes']]
    score.update(parent_v28_engineering_energy=score['total_engineering_energy'],
        ordered_support_unavailable=bool(failed),ordered_support_checks=checks,
        unchanged_intersection_angle_checks=angle_checks,
        directed_support_is_separate_from_angle_conditioning=True)
    if failed:score['total_engineering_energy']=float('inf')

def _actual_support_constraints(self,p):
        if not self.groups:return np.empty(0),np.empty((0,6)),[]
        q,_,jac, _=J.projection_and_jacobian(p,self.xyz,self.K,self.scale)
        values=[];rows=[];audits=[]
        for g in self.groups:
            k,mate=g['native_corner'],g['native_neighbor'];n=np.asarray(g['normal_unit_xy']);axis=np.array([-n[1],n[0]])
            s=np.asarray([axis@q[k],axis@q[mate]]);indices=[k,mate];lo,hi=np.argsort(s)
            actual=np.asarray(g['actual_inlier_xy'],float);coords=actual@axis
            lower,upper=float(coords.min()),float(coords.max());margin=11.
            finite=[lower-s[lo]+margin,s[hi]-upper+margin]
            finite_j=[-axis@jac[indices[lo]],axis@jac[indices[hi]]]
            directed=[]
            for owner in g['activation_owners']:
                anchor=owner['native_corner'];other=mate if anchor==k else k
                sign=owner['fixed_tangent_sign']
                if sign is None:
                    directed.append(dict(native_corner=anchor,order_ambiguous=True,
                        hard_order_guard_applied=False,slack_px=None))
                    continue
                sign=float(sign)
                ordered=np.sort(sign*coords);required=int(np.ceil(.6*len(ordered)-1e-12))
                cut=float(ordered[-required]);slack=cut+1.-sign*float(axis@q[anchor])
                orientation=float(sign*axis@(q[other]-q[anchor]))
                directed.append(dict(native_corner=anchor,slack_px=slack,
                    fixed_tangent_sign=sign,order_provenance=owner['order_provenance'],
                    hard_order_guard_applied=True,projected_endpoint_order_slack_px=orientation,
                    actual_support_fraction=float(np.mean(sign*(coords-float(axis@q[anchor]))>=-1.))))
                values.append(slack);rows.append(-sign*axis@jac[anchor])
                values.append(orientation);rows.append(sign*axis@(jac[other]-jac[anchor]))
            values.extend(finite);rows.extend(finite_j)
            audits.append(dict(component_id=g['component_id'],physical_native_edge=sorted([k,mate]),
                finite_actual_support_slacks_px=list(map(float,finite)),directed_support=directed,
                passed=bool(min([*finite,*[v for x in directed if x['hard_order_guard_applied']
                    for v in (x['slack_px'],x['projected_endpoint_order_slack_px'])]])>=-self.cfg['feasibility_tolerance']),
